## Activity

Oakridge Primary Care completed its planned screening activity during February 2024. A total of 93 captures were recorded at the site. Session lists ran as planned apart from routine leave, and no other disruption to scheduled activity was reported. The activity level provides the basis for reviewing image quality and grading outcomes for the month.

## Image quality

Of the 93 captures, 3 were ungradable. This represents an ungradable rate of 3.2 per cent. The number of ungradable images should continue to be monitored through routine quality review, with attention given to any recurring issues affecting image capture or assessment.

## Grading

There were 10 referable results among the captures graded during February 2024. The median grading lag was 1 day. Overall, the site recorded activity across the month, with most captures suitable for grading and a defined group requiring follow-up through the appropriate clinical pathway. Further review should consider the reasons for ungradable images and maintain oversight of grading timeliness.
